subject: Re: AWS private offer — staged evaluation, billing path, and close trajectory
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@federalai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@federalai.com
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS private offer — evaluation plan & PO path

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the throughput and caching behavior you showed. Procurement asked me to put together a short MAP so they can forecast approvals. Key asks from our side:

- A staged evaluation window (pilot, expanded pilot, production) with acceptance criteria for each phase.
- Clear billing path: we prefer an AWS Private Offer (marketplace) so costs flow through our AWS invoices. Procurement needs to know whether Redwood will accept that billing flow or require a separate invoice.
- PO and contract milestones and target close date (we'd like to be live by end of April).

I've attached a very rough spreadsheet that shows our proposed dates and owners (FederalAI_MAP_v1.xlsx). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept private-offer billing and whether you can provide a PO-friendly invoice option if required? Also, can you share a one-page summary for our procurement approvers and a draft SOW for legal review?

Thanks — looping in Amit (engineering lead) and procurement for visibility.

Samantha Liu
Sr. Manager, Cloud Platforms
FederalAI

Attachment: FederalAI_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@federalai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — evaluation plan & PO path

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the clear asks. We can accept AWS Private Offer billing and can also provide a Redwood invoice if procurement wants consolidated billing outside of AWS; both paths are workable but have slightly different timelines. I've attached an updated MAP workbook (FederalAI_MAP_v2.xlsx) with suggested milestones and owners. High-level summary below:

1) Pilot (2 weeks): 1–10 users, smoke tests, stability and latency targets. Acceptance: latency < 120ms p95 on 1k token prompts, no data exfil issues. Owner: Amit + Redwood SE.
2) Expanded pilot (3 weeks): 50 users, production traffic patterns, cost/per-token targets. Acceptance: cost within agreed budget band, performance SLOs maintained. Owner: FederalAI Eng + Redwood CS.
3) Production handoff: enable autoscaling pools, finalize private-offer in AWS, provide PO-friendly invoice if requested. Owner: Procurement + Redwood Billing.

On billing: if you take the AWS Private Offer, charges will appear on your AWS bill and we can configure the offer to map to the pricing in the MAP. If procurement needs a Redwood invoice (e.g., for accounts-payable aggregation), we will issue monthly invoices tied to the same pricing. NOTE: marketplace private-offer flow requires a short coordination window with AWS (we typically see 3–5 business days to finalize the PO once terms are agreed).

Attached: FederalAI_MAP_v2.xlsx, Draft-SOW-FederalAI.pdf, and a text file with the AWS private-offer proposal link (AWS_Private_Offer_Link.txt). I've flagged Marissa for billing logistics and Ben for SOW/legal redlines.

Next steps I propose:
- Redwood sends a one-pager for procurement by 2027-04-05.
- FederalAI confirms staged evaluation dates in the attached MAP by 2027-04-06.
- Exec signoff / PO submission by 2027-04-20 to target AWS PO activation by 2027-04-23.

If that timeline works for you, I'll generate a DocuSign for the SOW and send the procurement one-pager.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Tel: (415) 555-0123

Attachments: FederalAI_MAP_v2.xlsx; Draft-SOW-FederalAI.pdf; AWS_Private_Offer_Link.txt

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — evaluation plan & PO path

Karthik / Marissa —

Quick note on invoicing mechanics: Procurement will want visibility on invoiced amounts for budget forecasting. Two options we should explicitly present to FederalAI:

A) Marketplace (AWS Private Offer) only — charges show on FederalAI's AWS bill. Redwood provides monthly usage reports but no separate AR invoice.
B) Marketplace + Redwood invoicing — we accept the Private Offer for provisioning and also issue a monthly invoice (Net30) to FederalAI for record-keeping.

If they pick B, finance needs purchase order number and billing contact (we should include fields in the one-pager). Also, confirm payment terms (Net30 default; we can offer Net45 on enterprise deals).

I've attached a draft SOW for legal redlines and a sample invoice template (Draft-SOW-FederalAI.pdf).

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Draft-SOW-FederalAI.pdf

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@federalai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Reddy <amit.reddy@federalai.com>, procurement@federalai.com
Date: 2027-04-15T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — evaluation plan & PO path

Karthik / Ben —

Thanks for the update and the draft materials. Procurement prefers option A (AWS Private Offer only) but they still require a one-page summary with:
- short description of what will be billed on AWS (line items)
- expected monthly spend range during expanded pilot and production
- PO number field and contact for billing questions

A couple of constraints from our side:
- We would like to split the close into two billing phases if possible — a small trial credit and then committed monthly consumption once the PO is active. Can Redwood support a trial-credit workflow + marketplace billing for the remainder?
- Legal needs the SOW redlines by 2027-04-18 to hit our internal board review schedule.
- Security has a short questionnaire (attached separately); we'll gate production access on completed answers.

If you can send the one-pager and the revised SOW with redlines by EOD 2027-04-16, procurement will queue the PO for 2027-04-20.

Samantha

Attachment: (security questionnaire sent via separate email)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@federalai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, procurement@federalai.com
Date: 2027-04-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — evaluation plan & PO path

Samantha —

Thanks — quick status update and action list to close by 2027-04-28 as requested:

Action items
- Redwood (Karthik): Deliver procurement one-pager (attached) + DocuSign for the SOW by 2027-04-21.
- Redwood (Marissa): Coordinate with AWS to create the Private Offer; expected activation 3 business days after PO acceptance.
- Redwood (Ben): Prepare monthly usage reporting template and invoice-optional workflow (if procurement later requests).
- FederalAI (Procurement): Submit PO to AWS by 2027-04-23.
- FederalAI (Security): Complete questionnaire (we will provision pilot keys pending a pass).

We can support the trial-credit + marketplace billing path: Redwood will issue a small trial credit (applied as account credit) to cover the pilot window; subsequent consumption is billed through the AWS Private Offer. I'll include the trial credit details in the one-pager.

I've sent a DocuSign link for the SOW (https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerForms/abc123) and attached the finalized FederalAI_MAP_v2.xlsx and Draft-SOW-FederalAI.pdf with Ben's redlines applied. Please confirm/approve so Marissa can finalize the AWS Private Offer.

If procurement confirms PO timing, we'll schedule a kickoff to provision the pilot environment the next business day.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: FederalAI_MAP_v2.xlsx; Draft-SOW-FederalAI.pdf; Procurement-One-Pager.pdf
